# DRL-004: Prove clean-clone bootstrap and demo

## Metadata

- Milestone: M1
- Labels: `developer-experience`
- Owning mission: 01 Document Control
- Evidence owner: Document Control
- Requirement IDs: `DRL-SYS-003`, `DRL-OSS-002`, `DRL-OPS-003`
- Dependencies: DRL-001, DRL-002
- Public contract impact: NONE

## User / research value

A new contributor or clean-room reviewer can run the fixture research workflow without paid model APIs or tribal knowledge.

## Controlling documents

- `README.md` development entry points
- `Makefile`
- `VALIDATION_REPORT.md`
- `docs/00-program/CURRENT_STATE_BASELINE.md`

## Scope

### In scope

- Timed clean-clone on Linux (required) and Windows if available
- `make bootstrap`, `make doctor`, `make demo`, `make verify`
- Record toolchain versions and wall-clock times
- File gaps as Mission 01 issues (do not hide failures)

### Out of scope

- Implementing web apps
- Docker-only paths as the sole success criterion (Docker optional)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Clean clone from origin succeeds
- [ ] `make demo` produces the integrated fixture report
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0 or failures have filed issues
- [ ] Transcript attached with OS, Python, uv, Node versions
- [ ] No credentials required

## Verification plan

```bash
git clone <canonical-url> drl-clean && cd drl-clean
/usr/bin/time -p make bootstrap
make doctor
/usr/bin/time -p make demo
make verify
uv run pytest -q
```

## Security / privacy / licensing / cost

Must remain offline-capable for the fixture path. No private data. Cost: local compute only.

## Rollback

N/A — evidence issue; fix follow-ups via Mission 01 PRs.

## Evidence required for closure

Transcript artifact path or gist link; timing; open follow-up issue IDs if any.
